subject.title: fix(pdf): reject unsafe page numbers before analysis

question: Should an unsafe integer PDF page token invalidate the entire page selection rather than be ignored when it exceeds the configured page limit?
rationale: The fix removes ambiguous unsafe-number handling, but it deliberately changes the observable outcome of malformed mixed selections from partial success to fail-closed rejection.

options.title: Adopt Strict Validation
options.body: Reject unsafe tokens before PDF I/O after repairing the bounded regression test.

options.title: Retain Permissive Parsing
options.body: Continue ignoring unsafe values above the configured limit and pause or close this PR.

recommendation.title: Adopt Strict Validation
recommendation.body: Reject unsafe tokens before PDF I/O after repairing the bounded regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history around the PDF validation seam and subsequent PDF tool maintenance points here for the compatibility choice.
